description: The 2026 General Assembly Session gaveled to an end at approximately 1:00 a.m. on Friday, April 3. All Day 40s are chaotic and high-pressure, but the conclusion of this year’s Session was unusually dysfunctional and problematic. The Senate’s failure to address the election ballot deadline discussed below will very likely result in a Special Session called by Governor Kemp.
title: Session 2026 Ended
